text: yeah that clears that up for me, now, the next thing i need you to trace and get an itemized list for me just like this is, anything in the app that instruments via undo/redo history of any sort at all, but ISNT in the eventbus, what are they
resolution: Traced every active undo/redo, journal, snapshot-stack, and reversible history used by cart/editor and its host/runtime dependencies, then compared each mutation and replay path against the four actual editorbus publishers. Identified world-stack actions missing forward events, the entirely unbus'd mesh and model-paint journals, silent undo/redo restores for world/map/mesh/paint, the transport draft-point rollback, focused TextInput undo rings, and router back/forward history; separately excluded non-reversible recent/build/telemetry feeds and unused generic workspace history. Read-only audit; no source changes.
